## Fixes

- On Linux, the built executables now find `libcrypto_shim.so` (lean-libcrypto's shared library) when run directly, instead of failing with `error while loading shared libraries: libcrypto_shim.so`. Lake links it with `-L`/`-l` only and embeds no runtime search path on Linux, so the new `cryptoShimLinkArgs` in `lakefile.lean` (and its copies in the two samples and `scripts/check-jwt-dependency.sh`) adds an absolute `-Wl,-rpath` to its build directory, matching the absolute dylib path macOS already

- Linux builds no longer fail at link time with `undefined symbol: __libc_csu_init` / `__libc_csu_fini`. `postgresLinkArgs` in `lakefile.lean` (and its copies in the two samples and `scripts/check-jwt-dependency.sh`) added `-L` for the libpq libdir, which on Debian/Ubuntu is the system library directory; Lean's bundled linker then picked the system glibc instead of the toolchain's own, which does not match the toolchain's `Scrt1.o`. - The libpq smoke check (`Test/PostgresDependency.lean`) now decodes the hex encoding of `nyxis`, matching the value it compares against (#9).
